Annotation Interface DistributedLocked

@Target(METHOD) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented public @interface DistributedLocked
Marks a method that must run while holding a distributed lock.

key() is a SpEL expression. String literals must be quoted: 'order:pay' or 'order:' + #orderId.
